description: Test one data-size ablation by natively relabeling the original95 unused Cologne1 groups, then fit only three expanded-data OOF models and evaluate the same original100 held-out groups.

label_contract.aggregation: Mean of 450 post-step native SUMO halting counts summed over the eight controlled lanes and divided by eight.
label_contract.first_interval: Request one of the eight stored candidate phases through the unchanged safe executor for ten seconds.
label_contract.continuation: PhasePressure for the remaining440 seconds of every action branch.

native_prefix: Start with the original training seed and replay uninterrupted PP to each stored group interval separately for each candidate; do not restore saved SUMO state.
input_binding: Preserve original candidate order, observable features, contexts, priors, demand, network and public executor. Original restored-rollout labels for the95 groups are not reused.

label_budget.prefix_replay_cost: Account separately; native-prefix replay is additional simulation work.

fitting: Preserve original29 features, raw C_action-C_PP targets and A HGB settings. Recompute the unchanged A sample-weight rule only within each expanded fit fold. Exclude all groups of the heldout seed, including newly labeled groups.
policy: Original top1 ranking, threshold0 and S stay-veto→PP. Do not adopt I pre-mask ordering.
primary_comparison: Equal-seed OOF native label cost on the same original100 held-out groups versus cachedA andPP, with per-seed costs, matched action changes and harmful overrides. The95 new heldout groups do not enter this primary denominator.
collision_accounting: Record collision events as diagnostics without using them as an admission gate. An incomplete or invalid native branch remains reported and must be resolved before fitting; never substitute group IDs.
decision: Only an improvement on the full original100-group equal-seed cost can justify a later full fit or closed-loop comparison; retain per-seed harms and all label/prefix compute costs.
downloads: Keep banks, full traces and models server-side; retrieve only compact result JSON and needed logs.
limitations: Budget increases fromB100 toB195; any gain is an additional-data result, not an improvement at the originalB100 budget.
The extra groups add time-point coverage within the same three training seeds, not independent seed diversity.
The repeated original100-group comparison remains development evidence.

fit_contract.only_fit_change: Expand the fit-fold native data using the preselected95 additional groups while retaining A raw targets,29 features,HGB settings and sample-weight formula.
fit_contract.training_weight_source: Recompute the original domain/group balance, group-normalized target magnitude, sign balancing and mean-one normalization using only each expanded fit fold.
fit_contract.inactive_correction: Alias each fitted anchor in the alpha0 correction slot; no old full-data model enters any OOF fold.
fit_contract.raw_target_observation: Measure the maximum absolute raw delta for each expanded fold; the unchanged target_clip5 must remain inactive.

reference_frozen_threshold.selection_data: Original100 native B100 OOF records; fixed raw-target ablation and S stay veto

reference_a_fit_contract.only_fit_change: Fit raw action-minus-PP cost delta with C=1 instead of delta/R_group.
reference_a_fit_contract.training_weight_source: The original per-training-fold group-normalized target, original candidate-only domain/group weights, magnitude weights and sign balancing; keep these weights unchanged.
reference_a_fit_contract.inactive_correction: Alias each fitted anchor in the alpha0 correction slot; no old full-data model enters any OOF fold.
